correctness.rationale: The explicit operation (s,u)⋆(t,v)=(-s-t-ω(u,v)(u3-v3),-u-v) is an idempotent commutative kei, with affine quotient u◇v=-u-v on F3³. The latter has generated subquandles precisely affine subspaces. The medial-defect P0−R0 of the two pair-bracketings equals det(B−A,C−A,D−A), so four affinely independent projected generators create two distinct points in a fiber; their product is the third fiber element. Multiplying a full fiber by any preimage of another projected coordinate propagates full fibers everywhere. This proves generation iff affine spanning for ALL k. Rank-three 3×(k−1) matrices count projected tuples, 3^k lifts give G_k; previously established order 81 for free kei on four generators implies every surjective endomorphism is an automorphism, hence |Aut|=G4. Independently checked all 81² right-involution equations, generation closure of two distinct affinely spanning quadruples (81 elements each), and exact k=4 count. The actual source finite checker additionally supplies complete 81³ distributivity and 27⁴ determinant inspections, but its logs alone were not treated as a proof.

value.rationale: A complete intrinsic generation criterion for a classical finite nonmedial free kei, valid for every tuple length k, gives natural exact generation probabilities and automorphism order. This determines structural invariants that follow neither from order81 alone nor routine application of the orbit-stabilizer principle, and can support computational quandle statistics and random generation questions.
